findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "options-analytics" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: options-analytics_put-call-parity-check, options-analytics_max-pain-oi · Public sink: options-analytics_black-scholes-greeks, options-analytics_implied-volatility-solve, options-analytics_american-binomial-price, options-analytics_strategy-payoff, options-analytics_probability-of-profit, options-analytics_iv-rank-percentile, options-analytics_historical-volatility, options-analytics_volatility-surface-fit, options-analytics_put-call-parity-check, options-analytics_expected-move, options-analytics_skew-metrics, options-analytics_position-greeks-aggregate, options-analytics_covered-call-yield, options-analytics_occ-symbol-parse, options-analytics_max-pain-oi · Destructive: options-analytics_black-scholes-greeks, options-analytics_implied-volatility-solve, options-analytics_american-binomial-price, options-analytics_strategy-payoff, options-analytics_probability-of-profit, options-analytics_iv-rank-percentile, options-analytics_historical-volatility, options-analytics_volatility-surface-fit, options-analytics_put-call-parity-check, options-analytics_expected-move, options-analytics_skew-metrics, options-analytics_position-greeks-aggregate, options-analytics_covered-call-yield, options-analytics_occ-symbol-parse, options-analytics_max-pain-oi.
